historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission appointed Timothy Downey Associates, landscape architects, to design a play area, irrigation and other work for the rehabilitation of Alamo Square, for a fee of $16,500.

Alamo Square was rededicated with the Alamo Square Association on Saturday, November 15, 1980, after a rehabilitation, let to Arthur H. Shooter, Inc. in June, whose main work was an automatic irrigation system and extensive new planting.
